summary: Vertical Aerospace filed a Form 6-K disclosing board changes effective October 5, 2026: Clyde Woltman, ex-CEO of Leonardo Helicopters US, was appointed a director, replacing Carsten Stendevad and James Keith Brown, who resigned. Woltman's appointment was proposed by Mudrick Capital Management L.P. under its contractual director appointment rights in the company's articles, signaling continued creditor-investor board influence. No stake, price, premium, close date, or advisor was disclosed. The filing is a foreign private issuer current report, analogous to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02. Watch for further Mudrick-driven board reconstitution and governance shifts amid Vertical's financing and certification agenda.
